text.S1: The wife of a rich man fell sick, and as she felt that her end was drawing near, she called her only daughter to her bedside and said, "Dear child, be good and pious, and then the good God will always protect thee, and I will look down on thee from heaven and be near thee." Thereupon she closed her eyes and departed.
text.T1: Mukaintu waumwi mulombwana wakavubide wakaciswa, eelyo mukaintu nnakalimvwa kuti mamanino akwe aswena afwaafwi, wakita mwanaakwe alikke musimbi ambali abulo akumwaambila kuti, mwanaangu,koba muntu mubotu lyoonse alimwi akupaila, elyo Leza mubotu unookukwabilila lyoonse, ambeyo nookweembela kuzwa kuzwa kujulu akuba munsi-munsi lyako. Mpoona alya wakajala meso akwe wakazaya.
text.T2: Imukaintu wa umwi mulombwana wakavubide,wakaciswa, mpoona naakalimvwa kuti mamanino aakwe aswena aafwaafwi, wakaita mwanaakwe alike musimbi ambali aabulo akumwambila kuti, “Mwanaangu, koba muntu mubotu alimwi uupaila, alimwi Leza mubotu unookukwabilila lyoonse, ambebo ndinookweeembela kuzwa kujulu akuba munsimunsi lyako.” Mpoona wakajala meso akwe akutusiya.

text.S1: When winter came the snow spread a white sheet over the grave, and when the spring sun had drawn it off again, the man had taken another wife. The woman had brought two daughters into the house with her, who were beautiful and fair of face, but vile and black of heart. Now began a bad time for the poor step-child. They took her pretty clothes away from her, put an old gray bedgown on her, and gave her wooden shoes. "Just look at the proud princess, how decked out she is!" they cried, and laughed, and led her into the kitchen.
text.T1: Mweto nowakasika sikunku wakabikka icaanda cituba buu atala lya cuumbwe, mpoona zuba lyacilimo nolyakaboola walo musankwa ulya wakakwata umbi mukaintu. Mukaintu waletelezya bana basimbi bobilo mung’anda, bakali babotu akumeso mbubo bakali kulombozeka, pesi kabajisi myoyo mibi.eeci cakaba ciindi cibi kumwana wakajuna. Bakamunyanga zyakusama zyakwe zibotu,bakamusamika cikobela cakoona acalo,akumupa mabbusu akubeaza acisamu. Amukabotu kana kamwami kalisumpula nkaako,nkaaka kalalibonesya!” bakoongolola akuseka, akumutola kujikilwa.
text.T2: Iciindi camupeyo nocakasika caanda wakavumba atala lya cuumbwe, mpoona izuba lyacilimo nolyakaboola walo mulombwana uulya wakakwata mukaintu uumbi. Mukaintu wakaletelezya bana basimbi bobilo mung’anda, bakali babotu kumeso mbubo bakali kulombozyeka, pesi kabajisi myoyo mibi. Eeci cakaba ciindi cibi kumwana wakujana. Bakamunyanga zyakusama zyakwe zibotu, akumusamika cikobela cakoona acalo akumupa mabbusu aakubeza aacisamu. “Amukabone nkaanga namalelo nkokalisumpula!” bakoongolola, akuseka, muncikini.

text.S1: There she had to do hard work from morning till night, get up before daybreak, carry water, light fires, cook and wash. Besides this, the sisters did her every imaginable injury— they mocked her and emptied her peas and lentils into the ashes, so that she was forced to sit and pick them out again. In the evening when she had worked till she was weary she had no bed to go to, but had to sleep by the fireside in the ashes. And as on that account she always looked dusty and dirty, they called her Cinderella.
text.T1: 0okuya wakali kujata ncito kuzwa mafumina kusikila masiku, kabuka kalitana pola, kateka meenda, kukutula mililo, kujika akusanzya. Kunze biyo kwaboobu aba bacizi bakwe bakali kumutundulula munzila zinjaanji zitali zyabuntu—kabamweena akutila nyungu zyakwe mumulota, kutegwa lyoonse kakkala kabwezelela eeziya. Mangolezya naakali kubeleka limwi wamana kukatala katajisi abulo bwakoona, wakali konna munsi lyamulilo mumulota. Nkaambo kaboobu wakali kuboneka alusuko atombe, kabamwiita kuti ngu Cinderella.
text.T2: Ookuya nkwakali kubelekela kuza mafumofumo kusikila masiku, kubuka kucili kooko, kuteka meenda, kukutula mulilo, kujika akuakusanzya. Kunze kwaboobo, ibacizyi bakwe bakamupenzya mbuli mbobakonzya—bakamusampaula akutila nyungu zyakwe mulota, kutegwa ainduluke kuzibwezelela alimwi. Mangolelezya naakamana kubeleka kusikila wakatala wakanyina ibulo bwakoona. Wakali koona munsimunsi amulilo mumulota. Nkaambo ka boobo ciindi coonse wakali kuboneka alusuko atombe, bakamwiita kuti ngu Cinderella.

text.S1: It happened that the father was once going to the fair, and he asked his two step-daughters what he should bring back for them. "Beautiful dresses," said one, "Pearls and jewels," said the second. "And thou, Cinderella," said he, "what wilt thou have?" "Father, break off for me the first branch which knocks against your hat on your way home."
text.T1: Cimwi ciindi cakacitika kuti bawisi bakali kuya kumusika nkobasambala mpindu bantu, eelyo wakabuzya bana bamuzyaanyina ncobakali kuyanda kuti akabaletele ajoka. “Zyakusama zibotu,” wakaamba umwi, “mankwintankwita aninga,” wakaingula aumwi. “Ino yebo Cinderella uyanda nzi?” “Bataata, mukatyole mutabi wacisamu cili coonse cakusaanguna citi kajate ngowani yenu mwanoojokela kumunzi”
text.T2: Cakacitika ncakuti bausyi bakali kuya kumusika nkobasambala mpindu bantu, mpoona wakabuzya bana bakujana mung’anda ncobakali kuyanda kuti akabaletele akujoka. “Zisani zibotu,” wakaamba omwe, “Mankwintankwita angale,” wakaamba aumwi. “Ino yebo Cinderella uyanda nzi?” “Bataata, mukandityolele mutabi wacisamu cakusanguna cuuma ku nzyete yenu mwanoojokela kumunzi.”

text.S1: So he bought beautiful dresses, pearls and jewels for his two step-daughters, and on his way home, as he was riding through a green thicket, a hazel twig brushed against him and knocked off his hat. Then he broke off the branch and took it with him. When he reached home he gave his step-daughters the things which they had wished for, and to Cinderella he gave the branch from the hazel-bush. Cinderella thanked him, went to her mother's grave and planted the branch on it, and wept so much that the tears fell down on it and watered it.
text.T1: Nkabela baya basimbi bamuzyaanyina wakabaletela zikobela, mankwintankwita alimwi aninga, mpoona kaya kumunzi, kaya buya mukasyokwe kanyanzabili, katabi kacisamu kakamukoba akuunsya ngowani yakwe ansi. Aalya wakakatyola katabi akukatoleelezya kumunzi. Naakasika kung’anda wakabapa baya basimbi bamwi bobilo aumwi ncaakalaizyide, awalo Cinderella wakamupa kasamu nkaakabweza musaka. Cinderella wakalumba mpoona walulama kuya kucuumbwe cabanyina akuyoosyanga kasamu kakwe akulipwaya kulila cakuti misozi yakakawida akukatilila.
text.T2: Nkabela bakaula zisani zibotu, mankwintankwinta angale zya bana basimbi bakujana mun’ganda, mpoona nobakali kujokela kumunzi, naakali kucovwa mukasyokwe,kalemu, ikatabi kacisamu kakamuumputa akulosya nzyeete yakwe. Mpoona wakatyola katabi akukatoleezya kumunzi. Naakasika kun’ganda wakabapa baya bana basimbi izintu nzyobakali kuyanda, mpoona Cinderella wakamupa katabi kacisamu nkaakali kuyanda. Cinderella wakamulumba, mpoona wakalulama kucuumbwe kuli banyina akukasyanga katabi kacisamu atala acuumbwe, akulila misozyi cakuti yakakatilila katabi nkaakasyanga.

text.S1: And it grew, however, and became a handsome tree. Twice a day Cinderella went and sat beneath it, and wept and prayed, and a little white bird always came on the tree, and if Cinderella expressed a wish, the bird would throw down to her what she had wished for.
text.T1: Eelyo kakakomena, akuba samu lipati libotu. Wakali kwiinka ziindi zyobilo akukkala mujungusi lyacisamu, kalila akupaila, mpoona muyuni utuba wakali kusika mucisamu, eelyo naa kuti Cinderella wayanda cili coonse kumoyo, muyuni wakali kumufusila eeco ncaakaamba.
text.T2: Mpoona kakakomena, pele, akuba kasamu kabotu loko.iziini zyobilo abuzuba Cinderela wakali kuunka kuyookkala munsi lya kasamu, akulila akupaila, akayuni kasyoonto katuba kakali kuboola lyoonse atala akasamu, mpoona kuti Cinderella walombozya kuba acintu kufumbwa, ikayuni kakali kumusowela ncicona ncaayanda.

text.S1: It happened, however, that the King appointed a festival which was to last three days, and to which all the beautiful young girls in the country were invited. When the two stepsisters heard that they too were to appear among the number, they were delighted, called Cinderella and said, "Comb our hair for us, brush our shoes and fasten our buckles, for we are going to the festival at the King's palace." Cinderella obeyed, but wept because she too would have liked to go to the dance, and begged her step-mother to allow her to do so.
text.T1: Cakacita kuti, cimwi ciindi, mwami wacisi wakabamba pobwe lyaali kutola mazuba otatwe, kwalo ooko bana basimbi babotu boonse nkobakatambwa. Aba basimbi bamuzyaanyina nobakamvwa kuti abalo bakali babaabo bakaitwa, bakakkomana kapati, bakaita Cinderella akumuti, “Kotukamuna masusu, upukute mabbusu esu akutwaanga ntambo, nkaambo tuya kupobwe kumunzi wamwami.” Cinderella wakazumina, pesi wakalila nkaambo awalo wakali kulombozya kuya kukuzyana, mpoona wakakombelezya banyina kuti awalo bamuzumizye.
text.T2: Cakacitika, nokubaboobo, ncakuti imwami wacisi wakabamba pobwe lyakali kutola mazuba otatwe, kwalo kwakali kutambwa basimbi babotu mucisi coonse. Aaba bana basimbi bakujana mung’anda nobakamvwa kuti abalo bakali kuyandika kuyoojanika kupobwe, bakaba aakukkomana,bakaita Cinderella akwaamba kuti, “Kotukamuna masusu, upukute mabbusu eesu akutwaanga ntambo, nkaambo tuya ku pobwe kun’ganda ya mwami”. Cinderella wakacilila malailile pele wakalila nkaambo kakuti awalo wakali kuyanda kuunka kuyoozyana, mpoona wakakombelezya banyina kuti awalo bamuzumizye kuunka.

text.S1: "Thou go, Cinderella!" said she; "Thou art dusty and dirty and wouldst go to the festival? Thou hast no clothes and shoes, and yet wouldst dance!" As, however, Cinderella went on asking, the step-mother at last said, "I have emptied a dish of lentils into the ashes for thee, if thou hast picked them out again in two hours, thou shalt go with us." The maiden went through the back-door into the garden, and called, "You tame pigeons, you turtle-doves, and all you birds beneath the sky, come and help me to pick the good into the pot, the bad into the crop."
text.T1: Yebo wiinke, Cinderella!” wakaamba mutumbu; “ujisi lusuko atombe mpoona uyanda kuya kucisobano? Tokwe zyakusama amabbusu, elyo ategwa uye kukuzyano!” mbuli mbwakazumaanana kulomba, kumamanino banyina bakati, “Ndakutilila citiba ca nyabo mutwe, kuti ukonzye kuzibwezelela zyoonse mumawoola obilo, inga wainka andiswe.” mwana musimbi wakazwida kumulyango wakusule lya ng’anda mumbewu, akwiita, “nonkwilimba zivubwa, nonziba, anywebo noonse nobayuni muuluka mujulu, amuboole mundigwasye kubwezelela nseke ezi zibotu tubikke mumupika zibolede tusowele mumuunda.”
text.T2: “Yebo kuunka, Cinderella!” Bakaamba banyina; “Ujisi lusuko atombe mpoona uyanda kuya kucisobano? Tojisi zyakusama amabbusu, akuzyana tocikonzyi!” Mbuli mbwakazumanana Cinderella wakatolelela kukombelela kuli banyina, kumamanino banyina bakaamba kuti, “Ndakutilila citiba ca nyabo mumulota, kuti ukonzye kuzibwezelelel mumaoola obilo, inga wainka andiswe.” Mwana musimbi wakazwida kumulyango wakunze kuya mumbeu, akwiita, “Nywebo nonziba zivubwa, andinwe no nkwilimba, andinwe no ziyuni zyuuluka mujulu, amuboole mundigwasye kubwezelela zibotu mubike mumupika, zibolede tusowele mumuunda.”

text.S1: Then two white pigeons came in by the kitchen-window, and afterwards the turtle-doves, and at last all the birds beneath the sky, came whirring and crowding in, and alighted amongst the ashes. And the pigeons nodded with their heads and began to pick, pick, pick, pick, and the rest also began to pick, pick, pick, pick, and gathered all the good grains into the dish. Hardly had one hour passed before they had finished, and all flew out again. Then the girl took the dish to her step-mother, and was glad, and believed that now she would be allowed to go with them to the festival. But the step-mother said, "No, Cinderella, thou hast no clothes and thou canst not dance; thou wouldst only be laughed at."
text.T1: Mpoona nkwilimba zyobile zituba zyakanjila aampulungwido yakujikilwa, mpoona nziba zyakatobela, kumamanino bayuni boonse baansi bakaboola kabaza bulizyanya akubungana mutwe. Eelyo nkwiimba zyakazunganya mitwe mukuzumina akutalika kubwezelela-bwezelela , eelyo bayuni boonse bakasangana mukubwezelela-bwezelela akubikka inseke zyoonse mucitiba. Kalitanamana woola lyomwe bayuni bakamanizya mpoona boonse bakauluka bainka. Eelyo musimbi wakatola mutiba kuli banyina, wakakkomana, kasyomede kuti balamuzuminzya kwiinka ambabo kucisobano. Pesi banyina bakamwaambila kuti, “Peepe Cinderella tokwe zyakusama, alimwi tukonzyi kuzyana bayakwiile kukuseka.”
text.T2: Mpoona nziba zituba zyobilo zyakaboola zyakanjilila ampulungwido ya kujikilwa, alimwi nokwakamana kwakaboola nkwilimba, mpoona kumamanino kwakaboola ziyuni zyoonse zyuuluka mujulu, zyakaboola kazisokonya akubungana mu mutwe. Mpoona nkwilimba zyakazungaanya mitwe mukuzumizya akutalika kubwezelela, kubwezelela, kubwezelela, kubwezelela, azyakacaala zyoonse azyalo zyakatalika kubwezelel, kubwezelela, kubwezelela, kubwezelela, akubunganika zyoonse inseke zibotu mu citiba. Kalitana kwanan ioola lyomwe bakalili manizyide ikubwezelela, mpoona zyoonse zyakauluka zyakainka. Mpoona mwana musimbi wakabweza citiba akucitola kuli banyina, alimwi wakakkomana, akusyoma kuti lino balamuzumizya kwiinka ambabokucisobano.pele banyina bakaamba kuti, “Peepe, Cinderella tokwe zyakusama alimwi takonzyi kuzyana bayakwiile kukuseka.”

text.S1: And as Cinderella wept at this, the step-mother said, "If thou canst pick two dishes of lentils out of the ashes for me in one hour, thou shalt go with us." And she thought to herself, "That she most certainly cannot do." When the step-mother had emptied the two dishes of lentils amongst the ashes, the maiden went through the back-door into the garden and cried, You tame pigeons, you turtle-doves, and all you birds under heaven, come and help me to pick the good into the pot, The bad into the crop."
text.T1: Mbuli mbwaakalila bobuya Cinderella, banyina bakati, “Kuti kokonzya kubwezelela nyabo kuzwa mutwe muwoola lyomwe inga wainka andiswe.” “Eelyo bakaliyeeyela kuti mumasimpe inga takonzyi kucicita eeci. ” Banyina nobakamana kutila mitiba yanyabo mutwe, nakalindu ooyu wakazwida kumulyango wakunze lya ng’anda akoongolola kati, “ nonkwilimba zivubwa, nonziba, anywebo noonse nobayuni bauluka aansi lyajulu, amuboole mundigwasye kubwezelela tubikke zibotu mumpoto izibi tusowele mumuunda.
text.T2: Mboona mbuli mbwaakalila Cinderella akaambo kaaka, banyina bakaamba kuti, “Kuti kokonzya kubwezelela nyabo mu oola lyomwe nkokuti inga wainka andiswe.”Mpoona wakayeeya alike, “Kuti tacikonzyi kucita eeci pee.”banyina nobakamana kutila zitiba zyobilo zyanyabo mutwe, imwana musimbi wakazwida kumulyango wa kunze ya ng’anda akoongolola kuti, “Nyebo nonziba zivubwa, nonkwilimba, andinwe nyoonse nobayuni bauluka aansi lyajulu, amuboole mundigwasye kubwezelela zibotu kubika mu mupika, izibi tusowele mumuunda.”

text.S1: Then two white pigeons came in by the kitchen-window, and afterwards the turtle-doves, and at length all the birds beneath the sky, came whirring and crowding in, and alighted amongst the ashes. And the doves nodded with their heads and began to pick, pick, pick, pick, and the others began also pick, pick, pick, pick, and gathered all the good seeds into the dishes, and before half an hour was over they had already finished, and all flew out again. Then the maid- en carried the dishes to the step-mother and was delighted, and believed that she might now go with them to the festival. But the step-mother said, "All this will not help thee; thou goest not with us, for thou hast no clothes and canst not dance; we should be ashamed of thee!" On this she turned her back on Cinderella, and hurried away with her two proud daughters.
text.T1: Mpoona nkwilimba zituba zyobile zyakaboola aampulungwido yakujikilwa, kwakacilila nziba, kaindi kaniini boonse bayuni aansi lyajulu bakaboola kabazaa bulizyanya akubungana, akukkala mutwe. Nkwilimba zyakazumina amitwe yazyo kubwezelela-bwezelela, eelyo boose bayuni bakatalika kugomenena nseke izibotu kubikka mucitiba, kacitana kkwana cisela cawoola bakalimaniziye kale akuunka alimwi.Mpoona nakalindu wakanyamuna icitiba cakwe watola kulibanyina kakkomene kapati akusyoma kuti lino ulaunka ambabo kucisobano. Pele banyina bakati, “Eeci coonse tacikookugwasya pe; tokooinka andiswe nkaambo tokwe zyakusama alimwi tokonzyi kuzyana; inga watusampuzya!. Bamane boobo bakazyuuluka, akweenda abana babo basikulisumpula bobile.
text.T2: Mpoona inziba zituba zyobilo zyakaboola akunjilila ampulungwido yakujikilwa, mpoona kwakacilila nkwilimba, mpoona mukaindi kaniini kwakacilila bayuni boonse bauluka aansi lyajulu, bakaboola kabasokonya alimwi akubungana, akukkala mutwe. Mpoona nkwilimba zyakazungaanya mitwe yazyo mukuzuminizya kutalika kubwezelela, kubwezelela, kubwezelela, kubwezelela, mpoona zyoonse zyacaala azyalo zyakatalika kubwezelela, kubwezelela, kubwezelela, kubwezelela, akubunganika nseke zibotu muzitiba, mpoona kalitanasika akati ioola lyomwe bakalimanizyide, akuulukila aanze boonse alimwi. Mpoona mwana musimbi wakazibweza zitiba akutola kuli banyina alimwi waklikkomene, akusyoma kuti lino ulaunkka aabalo kucisobano. Pele banyina bakati, “Zyoonse eezi tazikookugwasya, tokooinka andiswe, nkaambo tojisi zisani alimwi tocizyi kuzyana, ulatusampuzya!” Nobakamana boobo bakamupa sule Cinderella, akweenda cakufwambaana abana basimbi babo bobilo basikulisumpula.

text.S1: As no one was now at home, Cinderella went to her mother's grave beneath the hazel-tree, and cried, "Shiver and quiver, little tree, Silver and gold throw down over me." Then the bird threw a gold and silver dress down to her, and slippers embroidered with silk and silver. She put on the dress with all speed, and went to the festival. Her step-sisters and the step-mother however did not know her, and thought she must be a foreign princess, for she looked so beautiful in the golden dress.
text.T1: Mbokwaanyina wakaliko aamunzi, Cinderella wakaya kucuumbwe cabanyina munsi lya kasamu akulila, “Kozungaana akubimba okasamu kaniini, kosowa nsiliva angolide aansi aalindime.”Mpoona ciyuni cakalosya cisani camubala wangolide ansiliva kulinguwe, amapatapata aamwekamweka aajisi nsiliva. Wakacisama cisaNi cakufwambaana-fwambaana, akwiinka kucisobano. Bana bokwabo abanyina tiibakamuziba pe, bakayeeya kuti mwana wamwami muzwa masi, nkaambo wakaboneka kabotu kapati mucisani cangolide.
text.T2: Mbokwakanyina wakaceede amunzi, Cinderella wakainka ku cuumbwe cabanyina munsi lya kasamu nkaakasimpa, akutalika kulila, “Ikubimba akuzungaana, okasamu kasyoonto, Nsiliva angolide kosowela ndime.” Mpoona ciyuni cakasowa cisani ca nsiliva angolide kuli nguwe, ampato zisumidwe aboya alimwi a nsiliva. Wakacisama cisani cakufwambaana-fwambaana akwiinka kucisobano bana bokwabo abanyina nkabela teebakamuziba pe, akuyeeya kuti ndiza wakali mwana wamwami muzwa kule, nkaambo wakaboneka kabotu kapati mucisani ca ngolide.

text.S1: They never once thought of Cinderella, and believed that she was sitting at home in the dirt, picking lentils out of the ashes. The prince went to meet her, took her by the hand and danced with her. He would dance with no other maiden, and never let loose of her hand, and if anyone else came to invite her, he said, "This is my partner.” She danced till it was evening, and then she wanted to go home. But the King's son said, "I will go with thee and bear thee company," for he wished to see to whom the beautiful maiden belonged. She escaped from him, however, and sprang into the pigeon-house. The King's son waited until her father came, and then he told him that the stranger maiden had leapt into the pigeon-house.
text.T1: Kwiina nobakali kuyeeyela kuti inga waba Cinderella, pele bakasyomede kuti walo ukkede biyo kung’anda mutombe kabwezelela nyabo mutwe. Mwana wamwami musankwa wakinka kuyoomuswaanganya,wamujatilila kukuboko akuzyana anguwe.Taakazyana anakalindu uumbi alimwi kwiina anakamulekezya kukuboko, alimwi kwiina angwakazumizya kumwiita, “Ooyu nguwangu,” wakali kwaamba. Wakazyana kusikila mangolezya, mpoona wakayanda kujokela kumunzi kwabo. Pele mwana wamwami wakati, “ndilainka aanduwe kutegwa ndikusindikile,” wakalikuyanda kuti akabone bazyali bakwe. Wakamutija, wakatijila mucaanda cankwilimba. Mwana wamwami wakalindila kusikila baisi Cinderella bakasika mpoona wakabaambila kuti nakalindu wakatijila mucaanda cankwilimba.
text.T2: Kunyina nobakali kuyeeyela kuti inga waba Cinderella, pele bakasyomede kuti walo wakakkede kung’anda atombe kabwezelela nyabo mutwe. Imwana wa mwami musankwa wakaunka kuyoomuswaanganya, akumujata kumaanza kuyoozyana anguwe. Kunyina umbi musimbi ngwaakali kuyanda kuzyana aawalo, alimwi taakali kukonzya kumulekezya kwaanza kwakwe, mpoona kuti kwaboola muntu uumbi kuzoomwiita wakali kumuvwiila kuti, “Ooyu nguwangu.” Wakazyana kusikila mangolezya, mpoona wakayanda kupiluka kung’anda. Pele mwana wa mwami wakaamba kuti, “Ndilaunka anduwe ndikusindila,” nkaambo wakali kuyanda kuyoobona bazyali kwakali kuzwa mwana musimbi mubotu. Wakamutija, akutijila mucaanad ca nkwilimba. Imwana wamwami wakalindila kusikila bausi nobakasika, mpoona wakabaambila kuti mwana musimbi mweenzu watijila mucaanda ca nkwilimba.

text.S1: The old man thought, "Can it be Cinderella?" and they had to bring him an axe and a pickaxe that he might hew the pigeon-house to pieces, but no one was inside it. And when they got home Cinderella lay in her dirty clothes among the ashes, and a dim little oil-lamp was burning on the mantle-piece, for Cinderella had jumped quickly down from the back of the pigeon-house and had run to the little hazel-tree, and there she had taken off her beautiful clothes and laid them on the grave, and the bird had taken them away again, and then she had placed herself in the kitchen amongst the ashes in her gray gown.
text.T1: Imunene wakayeeya, “Hena inga waba Cinderella? ”Eelyo bakamuletela keembe ajembe kutegwa aole caanda cankwilimba, pesi kwiina wakali mukati muli ncico. Nobakasika kumunzi Cinderella wakalilede azikobela zyakwe zyatombe mutwe, eelyo katoli-toli kakalikuyaka aasyonto mpokakalikukkala, nkaambo Cinderella wakasotokela kunze acaanda cankwilimba akutijila kukasamu kakwe, ookuya nkwaakaakusamununa zyakusama zyakwe zibotu akuziyala atala aacuumbwe, ookuya ciyuni nkocakazibweza akuzitola alimwi., mpoona walo waanjila mujikilwa akoona mutwe mucikobela cakwe cakoonena.
text.T2: Imudaala wakayeeya, “Sena inga waba Cinderella?” mpoona bakamuletela keembe alimwi apiki kutegwa ajaye caanda cankwilimba, pele kunyina wakali mukati. Mpoona nobakasika kung’anda Cinderella wakalilede muzisani zili aatombe mumulota, akalampi kamafuta kasyoonto kakali kuyaka amumuni musyoonto, nkaambo Cinderella wakasotoka kufwambaana kusotokela kunze kwa caanda cankwilimba akulundukila kukasamu kakwe, ookuya nkwaakasamununa zisani zyakwe zibotu akuzisiya acuumbwe, mpoona ciyuni cakazibweza alimwi, mpoona alimwi wakakukkala mujikilwa mumulota mucikobela ciboneka mbuli mvwi.

text.S1: Next day when the festival began afresh, and her parents and the step- sisters had gone once more, Cinderella went to the hazel-tree and said— "Shiver and quiver, my little tree, Silver and gold throw down over me." Then the bird threw down a much more beautiful dress than on the preceding day. And when Cinderella appeared at the festival in this dress, everyone was astonished at her beauty. The King's son had waited until she came, and instantly took her by the hand and danced with no one but her. When others came and invited her, he said, "She is my partner." When evening came she wished to leave, and the King's son followed her and wanted to see which house she went to. But she sprang away from him, and into the garden behind the house.
text.T1: Buzuba bwakaccilila cisobano cakatalika alimwi, mpoona bazyali bakwe abana bokwabo bakainka alimwi, walo Cinderella wakainka kukasamu kakwe akwaamba kuti, “bimba akuzungaana”, okasamu kangu, nsiliva angolide sowela ali ndime,” mpoona myuni wakafusa cakusama cibotu kwiinda cabuzuba bwakainda. Nkabela Cinderella naakabbuka kasamide cisani ciya kupobwe, bantu boonse bakanyandwa kukubota kwakwe. Mwana wa mwami wakalindila kusikila wasika, mpoona cakufwambaana wakamujata kukuboko akuzyana anguwe alikke kakunyina umbi. Bamwi nobakaboola kuti abalo bamwiite kukuzyana, wakati, “ooyu nguwangu.” Nokwakaba kumangolezya wakayeeya kweenda, eelyo mwana wa mwami wakamuccilila kutegwa abone kung’anda nkwaakali kuya. Pesi walo wakamutija, ngooyo mumbewu kunze lya ng’anda.
text.T2: Ibuzuba bwakacilila cisobano nocakatalika alimwi, mpoona bazyali abana bokwabo kabainkide kale, Cinderella wakainka kukasamu akwambaa kuti—“Bimba akuzungaana, okasamu kangu kasyoonto, nsiliva angolide kofusa kuli ndime.” Mpoona kayuni kakamusowela cisani cibotu kwiinda cakutaanguna. Mpoona Cinderella naakabonekela kucisobano mucisani eeci, boonse bakakankkamana kaambo kakubota kwakwe. Imwana wamwami wakalindila kusikila naakasika, mpoonampoona wakamujata kukwanza akuzyana awalo kakunyina uumbi pele alike. Ibamwi nobakaboola akumwiita, mwana wamwami wakaamba kuti, ooyu nguwangu.” Imangolezya nakasika wakalombozya kweenda, mpoona mwana wamwami wakamucilila kuti ,akabone kun’ganda nkwaakali kuunka. Pele walo wakamutija akwiinda mumbeu kunze ya n’ganda.

text.S1: Therein stood a beautiful tall tree on which hung the most magnificent pears. She clambered so nimbly between the branches like a squirrel that the King's son did not know where she was gone. He waited until her father came, and said to him, "The stranger-maiden has escaped from me, and I believe she has climbed up the pear-tree." The father thought, "Can it be Cinderella?" and had an axe brought and cut the tree down, but no one was on it. And when they got into the kitchen, Cinderella lay there amongst the ashes, as usual, for she had jumped down on the other side of the tree, had taken the beautiful dress to the bird on the little hazel-tree, and put on her gray gown.
text.T1: Kwakali samu lyakaimvwi lyakajisi michelo mibotu kapati. Wakalikwela walamatila akati kamitabi mbuli nginga silili cakuti mwana wamwami taakali kukonzya kubona kuti wabbila kuli. Wakalindila kusikila bawisi musimbi basika, mpoona wakati kuli mbabo, “nakalindu waceenzu wanditija, eelyo ndisyoma kuti watanta musamu liya.” Bawisi bakayeeya, “hena inag waba Cinderella?” kaamba kaaletwa mpoona samu lyakagonkwa, pesi kwiina wakaliko musamu.Nobakanjila mujikilwa ,Cinderella waklilede akati katwe mbuli lyoonse nkaambo wakasotokede kunze lya cisamu, alimwi wakalijosyede kale ickakusama cibotu kumuyuni kucisamu, akusama cibaki cakoonena.
text.T2: okuya kwakali samu libotu lilamfu lyakaimvwi lyakajisi micelo mibotu kapati. Wakakkwela akunamatila akati kazitabi cakuti mwana wamwami taakali kukonzya kuziba nkwakaunka. Wakalindila kusikila bausi nobakaboola, mpoona wakabaambila kuti, “Imwana musimbi wanditija, alimwi ndasyoma watanta cisamu ca michelo.” Bausi bakayeeya, “Sena inga waba Cinderella?” mpoona baleta keembe akuggonkka cisamu camichelo, pele kwakanyina wakali mucisamu. Mpoona nobakasika ku jikilwa, Cinderella wakalilede akati katwe, mbuli lyoonse, nkaambo wakali sotokede kulubazu lumwi lwacisamu, akutola cisani cibotu kuciyuni atala akasamu kabotu, akusama cikobela cakwe.

text.S1: On the third day, when the parents and sisters had gone away, Cinderella went once more to her mother's grave and said to the little tree— "Shiver and quiver, my little tree, Silver and gold throw down over me."And now the bird threw down to her a dress which was more splendid and magnificent than any she had yet had, and the slippers were golden. And when she went to the festival in the dress, no one knew how to speak for astonishment. The King's son danced with her only, and if any one invited her to dance, he said, "She is my partner."
text.T1: Mubuzuba bwatatu, bazyali abacizi bakwe nobakainka, Cinderella alimwi wakainka kucuumbwe cabanyina akuyooti kucisamu, “Kobimba akuyuuntana okasamu kangu kaniini, insiliva angolide kondiwaalila”. Ino aawa muyuni wakamufusila cisani cakali cibotu kwiindilila zyoonse zyaakasamide kale, amabbusu angolide. Naakainka kucisobano mucisani eeci kwiina wakakonzya kwaambaula mukunyandwa.Mwana wamwami wakazyana biyo anguwe, eelyo kuti umwi wamwiita kuti bazyane, wakali kuti, “ooyu nguwangu.”
text.T2: Mubuzuba bwatatu, ibazyali bakwe abana bokwabo nobakainka, Cinderella wakainka alimwi kucuumbwe kuli banyina akwambila kasamu kuti— “Nsiliva angolide kowaala kuli ndime.” Mpoona lino ciyuni caka muwaalila cisani cibotu kwindilila cakutaanguna acakacilila, ankwaabilo zyangolide. Mpoona naakaunka kucisobano kasamide cisani eeci, kunyina wakacikonzya kwambaula akaambo kakukankkamana. Imwana wamwami wakazyana awalo alike, alimwi kuti kwaba uumwi wakuyanda kuzyana awalo, mwana wa mwami wakali kwaamba kuti, “Ooyu nguwangu.” “Bimba akuzungaana, okasamu kangu, Nsiliva angolida kowaala kuli ndime

text.S1: When evening came, Cinderella wished to leave, and the King's son was anxious to go with her, but she escaped from him so quickly that he could not follow her. The King's son had, however, used a stratagem, and had caused the whole staircase to be smeared with pitch, and there, when she ran down, had the maiden's left slipper remained sticking. The King's son picked it up, and it was small and dainty, and all golden. Next morning, he went with it to the fa- ther, and said to him, "No one shall be my wife but she whose foot this golden slipper fits."
text.T1: Nokwakaba kumangolezya, Cinderella wakayanda kupiluka mpoona mwana wamwami wakayandisisya kuti ainke aanguwe pele wakamuloboka cakufwambaana cakuti kwiina anaakamutobela, nokuba boobu mwana wamwami wakamwiinda kumaanu, wakananikide bunzuka mwakwiinda moonse aboobo ibbusu lya nakalindu lyakulumwensi lyakanamatila akucaala. Mwana wamwami wakalibweza, kakali kaniini ikabotu kangolide koonse. Nobwakaca, wakainka kuli bawisi Cinderella akabbusu kaya, akuti, “Kwiina uuyooba mukaintu wangu kunze lya yooyo uukkwana nsumba mu bbusu eeli lya ngolide.”
text.T2: Nokwakaba kumangolezya, Cinderella wakayeeya kuunka, alimwi mwana wa mwami wakalibilika kuyanda kuunka awalo, pele wakamuloboka kufwambaana cakuti wakakakilwa kumucilila. Imwana wa mwami, wakamwiinda maano akujana nzila yakumugwasya kumujata, wakananika bunzuka moonse mwakwiinda, mpoona ibbususu lyamusimbi lyakulumwesyi, lyakajatilila, akucaala. Imwana wamwami wakalibeza, alimwi kakali kasyoonto alimwi kafwaafwi, koonse kakali biyo ngolide. Mafumofumo akacilila, mwana wamwami wakaunka aabbusu kuli bausi, akubaambila kuti, “Kunyina uumbi uutibe mukaintu wangu kunze lya ooyo uukkwana mu bbusu eeli lya ngolide.”

text.S1: Then were the two sisters glad, for they had pretty feet. The eldest went with the shoe into her room and wanted to try it on, and her mother stood by. But she could not get her big toe into it, and the shoe was too small for her. Thus, she was not the true one, and that the other sister was to put the shoe on.
text.T1: Mpoona bana bokwabo basimbi bakakkomana nkaambo bakajisi maulu mabotu. Mupati wakanjila abbusu liya mucooko cakwe mu ng’anda kuti akalisozye mukabbusu abanyina kabaimvwi aambali. Pele taakakonzya akujizya cinwe cakwe nkaambo kabbusu kakali kaniini . Nkokuti taakali nguwe mukamwini aboobo musyoonto wakwe wakeelede kusola awalo.
text.T2: Mpoona bana bokwabo bakakkomana, nkaambo bakajisi maulu mabotu. mupati wakaunka abbusu mun’ganda mwaakalikoona akusola kulisama, abanyina kabaimvwi ambali. Pele taakali kukonzya kunjila mubbusu nkaambo kuulu kwakwe kwakali kupati, ikabbusu kakali kasyoonto kuli nguwe. Icaamba kuti ibbusu teelyakali lyakwe, mpoona akuti mwanaokwabo wakaelede kusola kweezyeeka mu bbusu.

text.S1: Then this one went into her chamber and got her toes safely into the shoe, but her heel was too large. "This also is not the right one," said he, "have you no other daughter?" "No," said the man, "Except Cinderella." The King's son said he was to send her up to him; but the mother answered, "Oh, no, she is much too dirty, she cannot show herself!" He absolutely insisted on it, and Cinderella had to be called.
text.T1: Ooyu awalo wakanjila mucooko cakwe akusama kabbusu,tunwe twakanjila pesi kasindi kakwe kakali kapati aboobo tiikakanjila. “ooyu talinguwe pe,” hena tamujisi uumbi mwana musimbi?” “peepe,” bakavwiila badaala, “kunze lya Cinderella.” Mwana wamwami wakati awalo aletwe kulinguwe; pele banyina bavwiila bakati, “peepe kaka, ngusimatombe, teelede kulibonya!” pele wakazumanana cakusinizya, elyo Cinderella wakaitwa.
text.T2: Mpoona awalo wakalyeezyeka mu kabbusu kabotukabotu, pele kasindi kakwe kakali kapati. “Awalo ooyu talinguwe mwini wakabbusu,” wakaamba, “Sena tamujisi uumbi mwana musimbi?” “Peepe,” wakaamba mwana musankwa, “Kunze lya Cinderella.” Imwana wamwami wakaamba kuti aletwe kulinguwe; pele banyina bakavwiila, “Oo, peepe, ngusimatombe ooyo, takonzyi kulitondezya!” Wakabasinikizya mpoona Cinderella wakaitwa.

text.S1: She first washed her hands and face clean, and then went and bowed down before the King's son, who gave her the golden shoe. Then she seated herself on a stool, drew her foot out of the heavy wooden shoe, and put it into the slipper, which fitted like a glove. And when she rose up and the King's son looked at her face he recognized the beautiful maiden who had danced with him and cried, "That is the true bride!" The step-mother and the two sisters were terrified and became pale with rage; he, however, took Cinderella on his horse and rode away with her. As they passed by the hazel-tree, the two white doves cried— "Turn and peep, turn and peep, The shoe is not too small, and when they had cried, the two came flying down and placed themselves on Cinderella's shoulders, one on the right, the other on the left, and remained sitting there.
text.T1: Wakataanguna kusamba kumaanza akumeso wasalala mpoona wakainka wafugama kumbele lyamwana wamwami, ooyo wakamupa kabbusu kangolide. Mpoona wakakkala aakauno, waguzya kuulu kwakwe mucibbusu cilemu cacisamu, akubikka mu kabbusu, aako kakamukkwana mubwini. Naakanyamuka mpoona mwana wamwami naakamulanga kubusyu wakamuziba kuti nguyuulya nakalindu imubotu ngwaakali kuzyana limwi kucisobano, mpoona wakati, “ooyu ngo nabwiinga wamasimpe!”banyina abana babo bakayoowa kapati akunyema kutaambiki; pele walo wakakkwezeka Cinderella aabbiza akwiinka anguwe.Nobakakainda kasamu kaya, inkwilimnba zyobile zyakati, “Konyona akusondela, konyona akusondela. Ikabbusu takali kaniini, ”Nozyakamana kwaamba nkwilimba zyobile zyakaseluka akukkala amakkuko ookwa Cinderella yomwe kululyo yomwe kulumwensi, zyakacaala kazikkede mbweena obuya
text.T2: Kutaanguna wakasamba kumaanza akumeso wakasalala, mpoona wakaunka akuyoofugama kumbele aamwana wamwami, iwakamutambikizya ibbusu lya ngolide. Mpoona wakakkala akauno akugusya kuulu kwakwe kuzwa mubbusu lilema lyacisamu, akukubika mukabbusu ka ngolide, akumweelela kabotukabotu. Mpoona naakanyamuka alimwi amwana wa mwami naakamulanga kumeso wakamuzyiba akumuyeeya musimbi mubotu wakali kuzyana aawalo akukwiila, “Ngomukaintu wangu ooyo!” Banyina abana bokwabo bakakankamana akuutyompwa cakunyema; nokubaboobo, mwana wamwami wakabweza Cinderella akumutansyika abbiiza mbwaakamubweza akuunka aawalo. Nobakali kwiinda akasamu kasyoonto, inkwilimba zituba zyobilo zyakakwiila, zyoonse zyobilo zyakaboola kazyuuluka akuzokkala amagwezyo aa Cinderella, yomwe kululyo, mpoona iimbi kulumwesyi, zyakacaala kazikkede mbweena obuya.

text.S1: When the wedding with the King's son had to be celebrated, the two false sisters came and wanted to get into favor with Cinderella and share her good fortune. When the betrothed couple went to church, the elder was at the right side and the younger at the left. Afterwards as they went back, the elder was at the left, and the younger at the right. And, for their wickedness and falsehood, they were punished with loneliness as long as they lived. And Cinderella lived happily ever after.
text.T1: Kabalibambila kusekelela mucado, bacizi bakwe baluuni bobile bakaboola kabayanda luse kuli Cinderella akuti abaabanye bubotu. Aaba basikukwatana bobile nibakainka kucikombelo, mupati wakaima kululyo, musyoonto kulumwensi. Nokwakamana waawa kabapiluka, imupati nguwakali kulumwensi, musyoonto kululyo. Nkaambo kabubi abubeji bwabo,bakainda mucisubulo mumaumi aabo oonse. Pesi Cinderella wakapona buumi bwalutangalo kusikila kumamanino.
text.T2: Nobakalikulibambila kusekelela mucado amwana wa mwami, bana bokwabo bobilo bakubeja bakaboola kabayanda kuti abayande Cinderella mpoona abaabanye lubono lubotu. Ibakali kuyanda kukwatana nobakaunka ku cikombelo, imupati wakali kululyo mpoona musyoonto kulumwesyi. Mpoona nokwakamana bakajokela, imupati wakali kulumwesyi mpoona musyoonto wakaba kululyo. Alimwi nkaambo kabumpelenge akubeja, bakasubulwa aakulendelelwa mumaumi aabo oonse. Pele Cinderella wakapona buumi bwakukkomana kusikila kumamanino.
